title: raw_buf drain-at-least-one prevents stuck-forever invalid UTF-8
description: client.rs subscribe_events: when valid_up_to == 0 (the first byte in raw_buf starts an invalid sequence), drain_end = 0.max(1) = 1 discards that byte rather than looping forever. Without this, a stream of permanently-invalid bytes would never drain, raw_buf would grow to the 1 MiB cap, and the stream would yield SseFrameTooLarge instead of processing subsequent valid data. The max(1) is subtle but necessary; a contributor who 'simplifies' it to drain(..valid_up_to) creates an infinite loop. The comment explains the intent but the decision record makes it explicit.
